params.name: targetObj
params.description: Range or element or 4D Write Pro document

params.name: startRange
params.description: Starting offset of range in the area

sentinelValues.meaning: Beginning of the document/element (or of the element range if targetObj is an element reference)

params.name: endRange
params.description: Ending offset of range in the area

sentinelValues.meaning: End of the document/element (or of the element range if targetObj is an element reference)

overloads.semanticRole: Returns a new range object addressing the character selection between startRange and endRange within targetObj, usable for reading/writing attributes via WP GET ATTRIBUTES / WP SET ATTRIBUTES.

constraints: If targetObj is not a valid object, an empty range is returned.
A 4D Write Pro document contains not only visible text but also formatting tags, which are included in the range.

If targetObj is an element (table/row/paragraph/inline picture/body/header/footer/section/subsection), startRange and endRange are relative to that element's own start/end, not the whole document; for a section specifically, they are relative to the document body (the section's parent range).
